Package gui

Class UiCells

java.lang.Object
gui.UiCells
public final class UiCells extends Object
small shared helpers for rendering table cells consistently across screens.

currently provides applyStatusChip(TableColumn), which renders an order's status string as a colour-coded "chip" pill instead of plain text, using the .chip / .chip-* rules defined in gonature.css.
